the count is attained by genuine lifting nodes, so it is exact and not merely an upper bound: f_{c,b}(x) = 3^r c + b x has the origin as a level-r node with residual exactly c + b x along the all-zeros word, and adding 3^r x^2 contributes 3^{2r} x^2 which is invisible modulo 3^r, so the attainment is not an artefact of degree 1

block shift law: for a word w of length j the section operators send the state (3^j d, 3^{j+i}) to (d + 3^i packWord(w), 3^{j+i}), every such word survives, and at i = 0, j = e the 3^e words of length e reach exactly the states d + t for t in the balanced window W_e = [-(3^e-1)/2, (3^e-1)/2]; the shift is the balanced value packWord(w) and NOT the digit sum, and the distinction is load bearing because W_e is a complete residue system modulo 3^e while the digit sums are only the 2e+1 values |s| <= e

the shifted family separates residues: for every e >= 1 and R >= 0 the map d mod 3^R -> (B_R(d+t))_{t in W_e} is injective, where B_R is the depth-R behaviour of (d+t, 3^e) and W_e is the window of BTL-block-shift; proof by induction on R, using that W_e contains exactly one t_0 with 3^e dividing d + t_0, that t_0 is the unique window entry whose behaviour has depth at least min(e,R) when R > e, and that its entry carries the family of d' = (d+t_0)/3^e at horizon R - e; this closes the 3^{r-e} + e row count for all e, and it is false for the digit-sum window, where d = 3 and d = 6 modulo 9 collide at e = 2

normal form for the minimal deep-regime state: scale by a unit so that b = 3^e with e = min(v_3(b), r); then if v_3(c) < e the depth-r behaviour is the fully ternary tree truncated at depth v_3(c) and depends on v_3(c) alone, giving r classes, while if v_3(c) >= e the behaviour is exactly the unit-scaling orbit of (c, b) modulo 3^r with no further collapse, giving (3^{r+1}-1)/2 classes, and L_r is the sum; so the minimal state is the unit orbit degenerated to v_3(c) where the constant dominates the derivative, which identifies the quotient with classical Newton-polygon dominance plus Hensel rigidity and is why the branch closes as a reparameterization; bijection with behaviour classes verified for r <= 4

for Γ_NP, if E_|v|(s)=E_|v|(t) then T_v(s) lands on F iff T_v(t) does; length-n suffix acceptance is classified by E_n, not by residual coordinates. This is fold_on_F_iff, not a bound on L_0

for F(x)=x^2 and the infinite output language Y={0,+}^ω that never emits -1, the language L of trit words whose residual outputs of F all lie in {0,+} is not regular; equivalently the 3-adic preimage X=F^{-1}(Y) is not sofic. The prefixes 10^m are pairwise Myhill-Nerode inequivalent because the residual g_m(x)=3^{m+1}x^2+2x accepts w_m=(-1)^{m+1}0 while every g_n with n>m rejects it

for F(x)=x^2 write C_F(m,r) for the number of ≡_r classes among the unrestricted residuals of F at input depth m. Then C_F(m,r)=3^m whenever r≥m≥0, and C_F(m,m-1)=3^m-3 for every m≥2. The latter deficit is exactly three doubletons: for each σ in {-1,0,+1}, the two length-m extensions of σ^{m-1} by a trit other than σ are ≡_{m-1}-equivalent, and every other same-depth pair is distinguished

for F(x)=x^2 and r>=1, unrestricted ≡_r types at depth m>r inject into pairs (p mod 3^r, DZ^m(p^2) mod 3^r) for p in P_m. On the fibre p≡0 (mod 3^r): if m=2r the second coordinate runs exactly over the quadratic residues in Z/3^r Z, hence C_{x^2}(2r,r)<3^{2r}; if m>=3r the second coordinate is all of Z/3^r Z, via p=3^r + v 3^{m-r} for v in P_r. This decides the zero fibre, not C_{x^2}(m,r) for a general fibre. Cf. BTR-x2-C-band

for F(x)=x^2, r>=1 and m>=5r, every fibre p≡α (mod 3^r) of the interior map has second coordinate all of Z/3^r Z. Explicitly, for α,u in P_r the prefix p=α + u 3^r + 3^{m-r} lies in P_m, satisfies p≡α (mod 3^r), and DZ^m(p^2)≡2u + DZ^r(2α) (mod 3^r); the unit 2 makes u↦2u+const bijective. In particular no fibre stays incomplete for all m. This is not a first-saturation time of C_{x^2}(m,r). Cf. BTR-x2-C-interior
The LSD carry of normalizing the doubled trit stream 2 d_i, d_i in {-1,0,1}, stays in {-1,0,1}; 1 and -1 are reachable from 0.
V(c)=|c| strictly decreases under c |-> DZ(c+2d) whenever |c|>=2 and d is a trit.
Doubled-trit carry and output are odd: T(-c,-d)=-T(c,d) and the emitted trit negates.
The three carries -1,0,1 have pairwise distinct Mealy output signatures, so the 3-state machine is minimal.
The synthetic map T_3(c,d)=3 DZ(c+2d) satisfies c_n=3n along the all-+1 word, so the residual set is unbounded. This is not value-preserving normalization.
For T(n)=3n-lsd(n), lsd(T(n))=-lsd(n) and lsd(T^k(n))=(-1)^k lsd(n). Future LSD observations depend only on lsd(n).
Laboratory DZ is a left inverse of T: DZ(T(n))=n. Canonical T is the section I_{-lsd(n)}(n), not a constant-section I_a.
T(I_a(x))=9x+2a and lsd(T(I_a(x)))=-a, independent of the higher-digit residual x.
|T(n)| < |n| for all integers n, where T(n)=3n-lsd(n)
For T_λ(n)=3n-λ lsd(n), lsd(T_2(n))=lsd(n) and lsd(T_3(n))=0. The observational residual remains a trit; λ changes the residue map, not the need for the full integer.
For T(n)=3n-lsd(n), the length-2 integer jet satisfies J2(T(n))=(-lsd(n), lsd(n)). The map depends only on the first digit; every trit window (a,b) is sent to (-a,a).
The J2-orbit of T requires lsd(D^2(n)) or otherwise information beyond J2(n)
J2(T_2(n))=(lsd(n),0) and J2(T_3(n))=(0,0). Order-2 observation distinguishes T_2 from T, unlike the one-digit residual.

For T(n)=3n-lsd(n), the length-3 integer jet satisfies J3(T(n))=(-lsd(n), lsd(n), lsd(DZ(n))). Equivalently J3(T(n))=(-a,a,b) when J2(n)=(a,b). The third input digit is discarded. The map factors through J2.
J3(T(n)) is a function of lsd(n) alone
J3(T_2(n))=(lsd(n),0,lsd(DZ(n))) and J3(T_3(n))=(0,0,lsd(DZ(n))). T_3 collapses J1 and J2 but does not collapse J3: the second input digit survives.
D(x+y)=D(x)+D(y)+D(lsd(x)+lsd(y)). The missing state at the unary/Add boundary is D of the local digit sum.
D(x+y) is a function of (D(x), D(y), lsd(x+y))
If s,a,b are trits then D(s+a+b) is a trit. The streaming residual of trit addition is exactly {-1,0,1}. Three values occur on D(x)=D(y)=0, so the residual is minimal.
The shortcut map C(n)=n/2 (even) or (3n+1)/2 (odd) is well-defined on positive integers, and {1,2} is a 2-cycle.
V(n)=n strictly decreases on every shortcut step.
For every L≥1, n=2^L-1 realises L odd shortcut steps and C^L(n)=3^L-1>n. No residual n mod 2^L with blocks of length at most L certifies strict descent.
I_0(x)=3x. If |x|>1 then 3|x| is composite.
I_a(n) mod m depends only on n mod m.
The finite sieve residual gcd(n,210)=1 does not equal Prime: I_0(1)=3 is prime and I_0(211)=633 is composite, with 1≡211 (mod 210).
Equal length-L LSD jets have identical Prime continuation behaviour.
For λ=1 and |u|≤m, if |s|≤⌊m/2⌋ then |D(s+u)|≤⌊m/2⌋. The looser radius ⌈(m+1)/2⌉ from 3|D n|≤|n|+1 is not required.
For F_{λ,U_m}(s,u)=λ·D(s+u) and every integer λ≥0, a finite invariant box containing 0 exists if and only if λ≤2 or m≤1.
Gain λ=3 forces unbounded residual independently of the raw alphabet U.
For F_{2,U_2} the origin-reachable set is {-2,0,2} while the smallest invariant interval is [-2,2]. Interval invariance is not the reachable residual.
r-way trit addition s'=D(s+a_1+⋯+a_r) is F_{1,U_r}: a trit sum of length r has absolute value at most r, so the λ=1 box |s|≤⌊r/2⌋ is invariant. The count 2⌊r/2⌋+1 equals 1,3,3,5 for r=1,2,3,4.

If λ≥3 and |u|≥2 then the constant-control orbit of F_{λ,U} from 0 is unbounded: at λ=3 one has s'=s+u-lsd(s+u) so each step moves by at least 1; at λ≥4 the step is strictly expanding on the matching ray.
For λ=2 and |u|≤m, if |s|≤2 m.pred then |2 D(s+u)|≤2 m.pred. This is the sharp invariant radius 2(m-1)_+.
Holes or asymmetry in the raw alphabet U change the finite/infinite residual phase at fixed (λ, max|u|).
The minimal residual complexity M(λ,U) is determined by (λ, max|u|) alone.
For λ=1 and U_m, every integer s with |s|≤⌊m/2⌋ is reached from 0 by an admissible word. The explicit positive word is u=2,4,...,2n.
For λ=2 and U_m, every even 2n with |n|≤(m-1)_+ is reached from 0 by an admissible word. The explicit nonnegative word uses letters k+2 at step k.
For every finite U, the origin-reachable residual equals λℤ intersect the symmetric invariant interval.
Sign symmetry of U_m forces M(λ,U_m)=|R|/2.

If λ is not divisible by 3 and s≠t, the constant word of any letter of length v_3(s-t)+1 distinguishes the output streams of F_{λ,U}(s,u)=λ·D(s+u) with output lsd(s+u). Distinct residuals are therefore Mealy-inequivalent, so M(λ,U)=|R_{λ,U}| on every nonempty origin-reachable machine in this regime.
At λ=3, translation by 3k preserves every output stream: signedTrace 3 (s+3k) w = signedTrace 3 s w. This symmetry is not origin-reachable when max|u|≤1.
Some listed finite U at λ=1 or λ=2 has M(λ,U)<|R_{λ,U}|.
Identical immediate lsd signatures force behavioral equivalence of residual states.
If λ is not divisible by 3 and s≠t, every word of length v_3(s-t)+1 distinguishes the lsd output streams of F_{λ,U}(s,u)=λ·D(s+u). A common cyclic letter is not required.
3-adic residual rigidity requires a common cyclic or constant legal letter.
Some Model A–D finite control constraint merges distinct residuals at the same control state.
At λ=3, translation by 3k preserves the output stream of every word, so a control-language restriction cannot destroy that symmetry.
If 3^L divides s-t and |w|≤L, then the lsd streams of F_{λ,U} from s and t agree on w. A remaining-horizon L controller therefore merges (s,q_L) and (t,q_L) whenever that congruence holds.
If λ is not divisible by 3, s≠t, and |w|≥v_3(s-t)+1, then the lsd streams differ on w. Finite horizon preserves residual distinguishability exactly when a legal word of that length exists.
Some legal word shorter than v_3(s-t)+1 always separates distinct residuals, even when the control language forbids every critical-length word.
Finite control horizon creates residual merges only through deadlock or empty continuation.

If λ is not divisible by 3 and s≠t, the lsd streams of F_{λ,U} agree on a word w if and only if |w|≤v_3(s-t). A finite control language therefore merges (s,q) and (t,q) exactly when every legal word is shorter than v_3(s-t)+1.
A proper subset of the complete depth-L control tree can merge residuals that some remaining word of length v_3(s-t)+1 would separate.
If F(s,c)=λ·D(s+h(c)) then F(s,(d1,d2))=λ·D(s+d1 d2). Two-trit product residual factors through the raw contribution.
For trit pairs (d1,d2) and any gain λ, λ·D(0+d1 d2)=0. Origin-reachable residual of two-trit product forcing is {0}, matching F_{λ,U_1}.
Three-trit product has a different origin-reachable residual than two-trit product.
The two-trit product machine has a 3-state origin-reachable residual.

For every realized finite Juggler word w, n^{3^{#O(w)}} = T_w(n)^{2^{|w|}} + Δ_w(n), where Δ is the recursively lifted accumulation of local floor remainders. Δ ≥ 0, so the power envelope is a corollary; Δ = 0 iff every local remainder vanishes; concatenation is the two-term power-gap lift, not an additive sum.

For a realized Juggler word w, the first positive local remainder sits after a tight even or odd power-of-two prefix. That remainder contributes at least ρ_j^{2^j} to Δ, and the suffix operator Amplify (later remainders dropped) is a lower bound. An odd letter lifts an inserted defect by the exact cubic (x^a+D)^3-x^{3a} ≥ 3 x^{2a} D. Mixed OOE has firstDefect ≤ 1, with Δ ≥ 3 T(n)^4 ρ_0 or Δ ≥ ρ_1^2. These bounds do not claim Δ exceeds the formal surplus.

For a realized Juggler word, the relative slack 1+q = n^{3^{#O(w)}} / T_w(n)^{2^{|w|}} multiplies under concatenation: 1+q_{uv} = (1+q_u)^{3^{#O(v)}} (1+q_v)^{2^{|u|}}. An even letter multiplies by (1+η)^{2^k}; an odd letter multiplies by (1+q)^3 (1+η)^{2^k}. Running 1+q does not decrease under a realized extension. The surplus ratio R=Δ/S satisfies R≤1 iff T_w(n)≥n whenever S>0, so R is the endpoint comparison in other coordinates. A realized return T_w(n)=n uses the whole formal surplus.

Two consecutive persistent expanding Juggler residual blocks are impossible. Counterexample: 365 follows OOE to 763 and 763 follows OOE to 1749; both steps are PersistentExpandingResidual. An expanding O^a E^b block has a≥2, and a persistent residual endpoint is odd-to-odd so the next residual also has a≥2; that state is compatible with another expanding block. The n≤80 contracting sequels at 37 and 69 are a small-window artifact.

The integer exponent surplus of a finite Juggler word is E(w)=3^{#O(w)}-2^{|w|}, and E(w)>0 if and only if the word is formally expanding. An expanding residual block O^a E^b with b≥1 has b<a. On an expanding word, n^{3^{#O}}=n^{2^{|w|}+E(w)}. Relative slack multiplies under concatenation, and the slack numerator of a three-block word is n^{3^{o(v)+o(w)}}. The chain 365 --OOE--> 763 --OOE--> 1749 --OOE--> 4447 is a PersistentExpansionChain. This does not bound consecutive expanding persistent runs.

For a realized Juggler word, the pair (A,B)=(3^{#O(w)}, 2^{|w|}) multiplies under concatenation, and n^A = T_w(n)^B + Δ_w(n). The 1+q concatenation law is the same identity in multiplier coordinates: 1+q_{uv} = (1+q_u)^{A_v} (1+q_v)^{B_u}. In logarithms this is log T = λ log n - c and the weighted cocycle y_m = Λ_m y_0 - C_m with B_m = C_m/Λ_m. The local comparison c < (λ-1) log n is T_w(n) > n on an expanding word. These are the existing slack identities, not a new obstruction.

Four consecutive persistent expanding Juggler residual blocks exist: 1999 follows OOE to 5169, 5169 follows OOOOEE to 50093, 50093 follows OOE to 193753, and 193753 follows OOE to 887471. Each step is PersistentExpandingResidual.

Positive local slack, after the exact expansion weights, puts a nontrivial upper bound on the density or run length of expanding persistent residual blocks independently of T_w(n)≥n. In particular there is a uniform ε>0 with c/(λ-1)≥ε on every expanding persistent block, or the normalized budget B_m is bounded below independently of the endpoint tautology B_m≤y_0(1-1/Λ_m). Counterexamples: the OOE block at 180370579261640036336071806107777 has 0<q<10^{-30}; B_m/B_taut reaches 10^{-9} on the n≤4000 window; a length-5 all-expanding persistent run starts at 2183.

The local Juggler remainder satisfies 0≤ρ<2T+1, hence η=ρ/T^2 < 2/T + 1/T^2 and 1+η < ((T+1)/T)^2. For the mixed word OOE, 1+q = (1+η0)^3 (1+η1)^2 (1+η2)^4, and 1+q is strictly below the successor-ratio product ((T0+1)/T0)^6 ((T1+1)/T1)^4 ((T2+1)/T2)^8. The same bound at a successor start y depends only on the itinerary of y.

On realized odd-odd OOE starts, the last even remainder dominates the relative slack, and q_OOE(n) has order n^{-9/8}. After 329 follows OOOOOOOOE to y≈1.80·10^{32}, the next OOE block has 0<q<10^{-30} with q/y^{-9/8}≈2.64. Persistent expanding pairs have OOE-sequel q2 tracking y^{-9/8}. Large λ reduces successor q only by inflating y.

If a realized mixed word has q_w(n)→0 then the itinerary converges to an exact rigid monochrome tower. Counterexample: the mixed word OOE at 180370579261640036336071806107777 has 0<q<10^{-30}. Exact equality rigidity has no naive quantitative stability theorem.

A residual-shaped word O^a E^b is formally expanding iff 2^{a+b}<3^a. For a≥1 this is equivalent to a+b ≤ log₂(3^a), or b ≤ maxExpandingEvens(a). In particular a=2 or 3 forces b≤1, and a=4 forces b≤2. This is the syntactic expanding language, not a realized-orbit theorem.

For n≥2, PersistentOddResidual x y if and only if PersistentExpandingResidual x y. A contracting residual cannot overshoot, and 2^k=3^o is impossible for a nonempty residual. The expanding qualifier of a persistent residual is therefore redundant.

The expanding residual word grammar, or a finite residue-mod-8 successor automaton, is an independent obstruction to an infinite persistent expanding chain. Counterexamples: on n≥2 persistence already is expansion, so the attack reduces to T_w(n)>n; the OOE type self-loop 365→763→1749 exits odd-to-even at 4447; every odd class modulo 8 both continues and leaves the PE frontier. A finite run bound M is not proved and is not supplied by this grammar.

T(x)=m if and only if m²≤F(x)<(m+1)², with F(x)=x on the even branch and F(x)=x³ on the odd branch. The landing gap ρ=F(x)-m² satisfies 0≤ρ<2T(x)+1. Odd landing is membership of F(x) in a union of odd-m cells. These are the existing inverse-floor and remainder-window lemmas under landing names.

The normalized landing position θ=ρ/(2T+1) is a compact state for persistent odd-to-odd continuation: it occupies a proper subinterval of [0,1], or a coarse θ-bin predicts the next landing parity better than a residue class, or θ(T(x)) is a function of θ(x) and the branch. Counterexamples: on odd n≤2000, odd-odd θ occupies [0,0.997] and every tenth of [0,1]; PE-continuation landings span [0,0.995]; next-parity entropy given a θ-bin is ≈0.99, matching x mod 8; θ→θ transitions fill essentially all bins.
If x is odd, T(x)=y is odd, and ρ=x³-y² is the local odd remainder, then ρ is even. This is the opposite parity of peakOddDefect_odd, which requires an even maximum.

On a realized OO word with z=T(T(x)), the sequential defect Γ=x⁹-z⁴ equals globalDefect(x,[odd,odd]). The two-step polynomial (x³-ρ)³=(z²+σ)² is y⁶=y⁶. These are the existing OO slack identity and the local floor identities under sequential names.

The peak slack identity x³=(p^{2^r}+ε)²+δ, which requires an even maximum M, transports to a persistent odd-odd pair. Counterexamples: on every odd-odd start n≤2000, including the residual chain 365, 763, 1749, the landing y=T(x) is odd, so peakOddDefect_odd does not apply and peakOddDefect(x,y) is even.

If y is odd and T(y) is odd, then the local remainder ρ=y³-T(y)² satisfies ρ≡y-1 (mod 8). Consequently v₂(ρ)=1 when y≡3 or 7 (mod 8), v₂(ρ)=2 when y≡5 (mod 8), and v₂(ρ)≥3 when y≡1 (mod 8) and ρ≠0. The same congruences hold for any odd square below y³; the floor T(y)=⌊y^{3/2}⌋ is not used beyond selecting an odd landing.

Persistent-expanding residual history forces a 2-adic landing restriction stronger than y mod 8: either v₂(y³-T(y)²)≥r>1 at a PE endpoint, or y≡1 (mod 16) forces v₂≥4, or the valuation locks the next residual word. Counterexamples: 365 maps to the PE endpoint 763 with v₂=1; 33≡1 (mod 16) has v₂=3; on odd n≤4000 the PE valuation table is the residue law, and v₂=1 continues as both persistent OOE and non-persistent OOEE.

y=T_w(x) with x realising w if and only if follows x w and image x w = y. Each letter is the existing inverse-floor cell: T(n)=m iff m²≤F(n)<(m+1)² with F(n)=n on the even branch and F(n)=n³ on the odd branch. These are the itinerary and cell lemmas under cylinder names.

The predecessor cylinder of a persistent-expanding residual word constrains T(y) mod 2 or the next residual grammar in a way invisible from y, y mod 8, or θ(y). Counterexamples: 3461 maps under OOE to 9585 with T even and 3803 maps under OOE to 10657 with T odd; both endpoints are 1 mod 8 with θ≈0.382. On expanding overshoots n≤4000 every PE word with at least 8 samples realises both next parities.

Write oddLanding y for y odd and T(y) odd, and oddRun 0 y = oddLanding y, oddRun (r+1) y = oddLanding y and oddRun r (T(y)). Then oddRun (r+1) y if and only if y is odd and oddRun r (T(y)). The odd-landing cylinder of a fixed m contains at most one integer.

The iterated odd-landing sets P_r occupy shrinking arithmetic cylinders, or iteration is recognized modulo 2^m, or successive square-gap coordinates on long odd runs are constrained. Counterexamples: on odd n≤8000 the stay fraction |P_{r+1}|/|P_r| is 0.49–0.53 through r=7; P_r is mostly isolated odds; every residue modulo 64 both continues and exits; θ on P_r and on the exit from P_{r-1} both occupy [0,1].

For every natural n and finite parity word w, follows n w if and only if the actual length-|w| Juggler itinerary of n equals w. The word image equals the |w|-fold iterate, and images and realization compose under word concatenation.
If n and m realize the same finite Juggler word w and n ≤ m, then the image of n after w is at most the image of m after w.
For every finite Juggler word w realized at n, J^{|w|}(n)^{2^{|w|}} ≤ n^{3^{#O(w)}}. If n ≥ 2 and 3^{#O(w)} < 2^{|w|}, then J^{|w|}(n) < n.

The even fiber J(n)=m is the parity-restricted square interval m² ≤ n < (m+1)², while the odd fiber is the parity-restricted cube-to-square interval m² ≤ n³ < (m+1)²; any odd fiber contains at most one integer.

Every nontrivial Juggler cycle word based at n ≥ 2 is formally expanding. Cycle extrema satisfy the certified parity, order, square-scale, and nested-cell constraints; a minimum-based cycle orientation cannot end in an odd letter. The path from a cycle minimum to any later even state is superquadratic. These are necessary cycle restrictions, not an exclusion of all cycles.

For S_O(N) = sum over odd n ≤ N of (-1)^{floor(n^{3/2})}, the exact fractional-part formulation together with the classical van der Corput and Erdős–Turán inequalities gives |S_O(N)| ≪ N^{5/6}. This is an ambient odd-input bound, not a Juggler-orbit transfer theorem.

The odd-to-odd Juggler starts have natural density 1/4. Equivalently, the starts that admit a uniform one- or two-step FiniteProgress certificate (every even start n ≥ 2, and every odd start whose first image is even) have natural density 3/4. This is the counting corollary |OO(N)-N/4| ≪ N^{5/6} of the ambient odd-input discrepancy bound. It is a density of that uniform short-certificate class, not of all FiniteProgress, not of ReachesOne, and not a Lean counting theorem.

Universal FiniteProgress for starts above one implies universal reachability of one. Every even start n ≥ 2 and every odd start n ≥ 2 whose first image is even has FiniteProgress; consequently, any start without FiniteProgress is odd and has an odd first image. This isolates the automatic odd-to-odd frontier without proving universal progress.

Neither OOOEOE nor OOOOEE is a Juggler cycle word at any n ≥ 2. The argument is an exhaustive evaluation for n < 256 together with the last-even cell against the coarse lower envelope n^{81} > 2^{130}(n+1)^{64} for n ≥ 256. This excludes those two orientations only: it is not a length-six census and not an exclusion of all cycles.
